sections.heading: Hey, I'm Jared.
sections.label: Founder & Builder
sections.text: I run Bestly out of Los Angeles. We build private cloud servers for businesses (In-House Cloud), privacy-first apps and browser extensions, and a few physical products. Everything ships with the same default: collect less, ask first, never sell.Los Angeles, California

sections.heading: Why I Started This
sections.text: I got tired of building things that worked against the people using them — products designed to extract data, exploit attention, and maximize engagement at all costs.So I started building the opposite. Technology that makes life better without making privacy worse. That's not a tagline — it's how I decide what to build and what to skip.

sections.heading: Lean by Design
sections.text: Bestly is founder-led and intentionally lean. No outside investors pushing us to monetize your data. No board meetings debating whether to sell your information.This structure lets us move fast and stay principled — from software to physical products, the same standards apply to everything we ship.

sections.heading: It actually says no
sections.label: The big one
sections.text: Most cookie blockers just hide the pop-up — some even click 'Accept all' to make it vanish, which is the opposite of privacy. Cookie Yeti clicks 'Reject' for real, so websites can't follow you around.

sections.heading: It never goes stale
sections.text: Other cookie blockers slowly stop working — the maker moves on and the tool quietly rots. Cookie Yeti keeps learning. When a pop-up is tricky, our AI figures out how to close it, and that fix instantly reaches everyone using Cookie Yeti. It keeps getting smarter on its own, with nothing for you to update.

sections.heading: It won't break your sites

sections.heading: Key Features
sections.text: Sensor-driven awareness, designed for your daily cruising altitude.

sections.heading: AirPods-Based Tracking
sections.text: Uses AirPods motion data for higher-fidelity head and neck angle detection — tracking posture where it actually matters.

sections.heading: Phone-Based Fallback
sections.text: Works without AirPods using iPhone motion sensors. Lower precision, but always available for every session.

sections.heading: Live Activities
sections.text: View your current posture state at a glance. Persistent, real-time feedback without opening the app.

sections.heading: "Flying Too Long" Alerts
sections.text: Time-aware alerts when you've held a strained posture for too long. Gentle nudges, not constant interruptions.

sections.heading: Session Monitoring
sections.text: Start and stop posture "flights" during work, study, or focus time. Track your awareness over time.

sections.heading: Privacy-First Design
sections.text: No cameras. No recordings. No biometric identity storage. Your posture data stays on your device.

sections.heading: Who It's For
sections.text: Desk workers & remote professionalsStudents & creatorsAirPods users seeking passive awarenessAnyone with screen-related neck fatigue

sections.heading: Your Posture, Your Data
